# Happiness Squad

> Science-backed employee wellbeing and organizational flourishing solutions designed to reduce stress, prevent burnout, and enhance workplace performance.

Happiness Squad, founded by Ashish Kothari, offers comprehensive programs including leadership training, stress management, and human flourishing initiatives for organizations and professionals. The platform combines research-backed methodologies with practical coaching to transform workplace culture and employee engagement.

## Key Topics

- Employee Wellbeing
- Workplace Flourishing
- Leadership Development
- Stress Management
- Burnout Prevention
- Organizational Culture
- Human Flourishing
- Corporate Training
- Work-Life Balance
- Employee Engagement
- Ashish Kothari
- Rewire Programs
- Management Mastery
- Flourishing Edge
- Hardwired for Happiness

## Core Programs

- [Flourishing Edge™](https://happinesssquad.com/flourishing-edge): Organizational human flourishing programs designed to transform workplace culture and employee satisfaction
- [Rewire](https://happinesssquad.com/rewire-teams): Corporate wellbeing programs for team performance, stress reduction, and workplace resilience
- [Management Mastery](https://happinesssquad.com/management-mastery): Leadership training program for managers to develop effective team leadership and organizational impact
- [Peak Performance](https://happinesssquad.com/peak-performance): Management mastery coaching focused on team leadership and organizational excellence
- [Catalyst Offerings](https://happinesssquad.com/catalyst-offerings): Employee engagement workshops utilizing the PEARL model for organizational transformation

## Specialized Wellbeing Programs

- [Rewire Professionals](https://happinesssquad.com/rewire-professionals): Stress reduction and burnout prevention coaching for working professionals
- [Rewire Yogis](https://happinesssquad.com/rewire-yogis): Corporate wellbeing program tailored for yoga practitioners and wellness enthusiasts
- [Rewire Yoga Teachers](https://happinesssquad.com/rewire-yoga-teachers): Workplace wellness programs and support specifically designed for yoga instructors
